Using regulatory bans as proxy weapons in broader trade skirmishes penalizes compliant businesses and distorts regional markets.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The error lies in evaluating regulatory compliance (HOW) through the lens of political protectionism (WHO).

Social Physics Analysis:
Domestic sugar lobbies ran a Smart Selfish Maneuver by manufacturing crisis narratives around blended molasses imports, using state power as a pretext to crush rival refiners while projecting blame for quota leakage onto foreign actors.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. Protectionist lobbying successfully bends trade policy to suppress market competition.

The Unavoidable Truth: The molasses ban protects domestic sugar producers from foreign market competition.

The Unavoidable Lie: The import ban is purely an objective technical correction of tariff loopholes.
